individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap-style distributions overlaid on tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmaps with a color-intensity scale, not an averaged value with error bars, so no definition is required.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots in panel B show overlaid individual data points as scatter dots in addition to the box-and-whisker summary.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile
error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption explicitly defines the box plot elements, including quartiles, median, minima and maxima for each group.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The enrichment score line plots show no error bars, and the accompanying NES/FDR/p values are point statistics, not averages requiring variability bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: The bar graph plots a single log2 fold-change value per gene with p-values annotated, but no individual data points or replicate values underlying each bar are shown.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph shows only a single fold-change value per gene with no error bars drawn, so nothing needs to be defined.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E consists of micrographs, not a plot, so this check does not apply.
